t: Ahead of the Curve
s: From its start in 1990, Curve magazine was a visionary and unapologetic celebration of lesbian life. Facing the magazine’s possible demise in 2019, director Jen Rainin and Curve founder Franco Stevens explore questions of lesbian visibility, legacy, and current day issues.
